gaps.sentence: Not since the 1990s ___ unemployment been so low.
gaps.explanation: Not since X has Y happened — present perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only by practising daily ___ you improve your fluency.
gaps.explanation: Only by doing X will you… — future inversion after only by.

gaps.sentence: Nowhere ___ the report mention the missing funds.
gaps.explanation: Nowhere does the report mention… — present simple inversion.

gaps.sentence: Never ___ I imagine the project would take two years.
gaps.explanation: Never would I have imagined… — conditional flavour with inversion.

gaps.sentence: To ___ did you address that complaint, exactly?
So convincing ___ his argument that nobody objected.
gaps.explanation: So + adjective at the front: was his argument that…

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ she apologise, she also paid for the damage.
gaps.explanation: Not only did she…, (but) she also… — inversion after not only.

gaps.sentence: Among the guests ___ the ambassador and her staff.
gaps.hint: fronted 'among' — verb agrees with later subject
gaps.explanation: Among the guests were the ambassador and her staff — verb before subject.
